scope: Validation-selected follow-up improvement; original results retained
test_status: Original test results and failure gallery have already been inspected. New test results are a development follow-up, not a pristine independent confirmation.
split: Same official corrected CAMUS 400/50/50 membership; no test patients in fitting or selection
architecture: Five-level U-Net: four max-pool downsamplings, base width 16, instance normalization, LeakyReLU, transposed-convolution upsampling, deep supervision
preprocessing: Per-image 1st/99th percentile scaling, aspect-preserving letterbox to 256 square, native-grid restoration for scoring
optimizer: AdamW; cosine schedule to 1e-5; gradient clipping norm 5
augmentation: Paired affine: rotation +/-10 degrees, scale 0.9 to 1.1, translation +/-8% on each axis; no mirroring or test augmentation
loss: Average CE/foreground soft Dice at four decoder resolutions, auxiliary weights 1,0.5,0.25,0.125 normalized to sum one
checkpoint_selection: Highest native-grid validation foreground macro-Dice per seed; earliest tie
inference_candidates: Each selected seed checkpoint and equal-probability ensemble; each with none or largest four-connected component per class (six candidates)
final_selection: Validation Dice maximum; candidates within 0.001 of maximum are compared by fewer undefined empty-mask distance failures, lower validation mean HD95 (undefined ranks last), fewer members, then lexical ID. Config frozen before test evaluation.
test_evaluation: Evaluate only the frozen selected config once; compare with stored original baseline using patient-paired bootstrap differences (2000 replicates, seed42). Do not retune after seeing test results.
compute_budget: Two fixed 120-epoch CUDA runs; stop search after these six inference configurations
